messages.subject: About queries for the CRMA v2 paper
parts:
Hi,

I get a lot of request (online and offline) on sharing the CRMA v2
manuscript. The manuscript was submitted on Nov 4 to Bioinformatics
and we are still waiting to hear back from the journal and the
reviewers. When we hear back from them and if the comments are
positive, we will consider sharing this manuscript. Then, please let
us know your name and affiliation.

BTW, I and others would appreciate if everyone on this list would (at
least) once share their names and affiliations (beyond an often
anonymous email address) - this is an open source project and
community.

Cheers

Henrik
